title: VTC Events — Guests — Withdraw — payload
description: A guest withdraws their registration for an event. Always allowed; the reply is their receipt. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Events — Guests — Withdraw — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/guests/withdraw/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/guests/withdraw/0.1#response.

changed.description: False when the registration was already withdrawn or closed by a host.
